test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

‘Angulimala’ lived by __training__ travellers and feared no one.
solution:
The correct answer is "**plundering**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Training** means **teaching** a skill to a person **consistently**. 

 
 
• **Example**:* Mark is taking **training** to become an athlete. *
 
 
 
• **Plundering** means taking** something forcefully.** 
 
 
• **Example**: *Gill is working hard to **plunder** the trophy. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is plundering.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Distilling** - to take the essence of something.

 
 
• **Example:** *The team leader has to **distil** the meeting to make a report.*
 
 
 
• **Mischallenging** - a challenge that is improper.
 
 
• **Example:** *The friends took the task **mischallenging**. *
 
 
 
• **Disillusioning** - To disappoint someone by breaking their belief about someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** *I **disillusioned** Ron by bringing out the true color of his friend. *
